{{Top|leg}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''listening post''' on the [[Tifnyl's moon|moon]] of [[Tifnyl]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was staffed by ten [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] and ten [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]] and supplied one a month by one of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector's]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. The military value of the post was negligible; [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Villis Andal]] established the post to get extra [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] allocated to his [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
